name: shevolution
description: Shevolution: women's safety + SOS platform (Android safety layer, web app, Firebase backend)

scripts.build:apk:win: npm run build:web && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File android/build.ps1
scripts.firebase:setup: firebase firestore:databases:create shevolution --location=asia-south1 --project ideathon-projects && firebase hosting:sites:create shevolution-ideathon --project ideathon-projects
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only hosting:shevolution-ideathon,functions:shevolution,firestore:shevolution --project ideathon-projects
